title: compose_script tool schema
description: Synchronous creative-writing utility for scripts, screenplays, storyboards, treatments, ad concepts, trailers, social shorts, campaign beats, and talking-head plans. Directly runnable prompts for named media models belong to enhance_prompt.

brief.description: The creative writing brief, story idea, product concept, video idea, or revision request.

script_type.description: The kind of script or creative writing artifact to produce.

destination_model.description: Optional destination video model selector, such as ltx25, ltx23, wan22, or seedance2.

destination_tool.description: Optional downstream tool, such as generate_video, animate_photo, sound_to_video, or video_to_video.

duration_seconds.description: Requested runtime for a video prompt, social short, ad, or talking-head script.

scene_count.description: Requested number of scenes, shots, beats, or storyboard panels.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional target aspect ratio, such as 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, or 21:9.

platform.description: Optional target platform or context, such as TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, broadcast, landing page, game trailer, or pitch deck.

style.description: Optional style, genre, tone, visual treatment, or brand voice to preserve.

first_frame_description.description: Optional description of the starting frame when composing an image-to-video prompt without attached vision content.

first_frame_data_url.description: Optional inline image data URI for the starting frame when composing an image-to-video or first-frame video prompt.

last_frame_data_url.description: Optional inline image data URI for the ending frame when composing an image-to-video transition prompt.

return_format.description: Requested output format. Use script unless structured planning output is explicitly needed.
